build_minlstm_model: build a language model using LMMinLSTM with LMMinLSTMArgs for vocab size and weight tying config
run_minlstm_forward: run the LMMinLSTM forward pass with token values and optional target tensor for loss computation
create_minlstm_args: create an LMMinLSTMArgs dataclass to configure vocab size, weight tying, seed, and loss reduction
reset_minlstm_parameters: reset LMMinLSTM model parameters using trunc normal initialization with configurable init standard deviation
get_no_recompute_ops: get the set of torch ops to exclude from gradient checkpointing recomputation for minLSTM
